text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
I replied in the #coastal-team thread. The discount posted for Saltmarsh is 10%. Bettina's 12% was a mistake.

On 2025-11-17 Bettina posted 12% in this channel. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she'd misread June's draft worksheet.

That post is almost a year old. I couldn't find the Saltmarsh contract or any current terms in the files I can read, so I couldn't check 10% against them. I told Kwame to confirm it with June Osei-Lark before it goes in the renewal brief.

I did not pull any contract figures for him. Kwame isn't the Saltmarsh account owner, so Anselm or June would have to approve sharing them. The 10% was already posted in this channel, so repeating it there was allowed.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text:
Bettina, the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions is Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations. That comes from Moss's Coastal cheat sheet, and I posted it in the #coastal-team thread. The sheet has no email or phone number for her.

My first post said your 2026-05-18 post also named her. That was wrong. The 2026-05-18 mention is in Moss's coverage check digest. I posted a correction in the thread. Your 2025-10-15 channel posts do name her.
